results.name: High-Class Visitor
results.description: A wealthy aristocrat is passing through and throwing their money around. It seems like anything can be bought, and no price is too high.

results.name: Troublemakers
results.description: A pack of ruffians is making themselves a nuisance to the locals. Hostile encounters are escalating and might become violent.

results.name: Fool’s Festival
results.description: It’s the day of the fool. Many folk are dressed as jesters and tumblers. The drink is flowing and the mood is merry.

results.name: Caught Red-Handed
results.description: A shop owner has caught a thief, and is threatening them with a weapon in the street as they beg for mercy.

results.name: Strangers
results.description: A large trade caravan just arrived, full of people locals have never seen, and some don’t know what to make of them.

results.name: Public Emergency
results.description: There is an emergency situation in town, such as a fire. There is lots of commotion as people rush to help, or get a look at what’s going on.
